rules.topic: Every Industrial Foregoing machine has a config triple: powerPerOperation is FE consumed PER TICK while working (despite the name), maxProgress is ticks per work cycle, and maxStoredPower is the internal buffer (10000 FE for most machines). Energy per operation = powerPerOperation x maxProgress; all values are per-machine config defaults in com.buuz135.industrial.config.machine

value.model: FE per operation = powerPerOperation (FE/t) x maxProgress (ticks)

rules.topic: The laser drill is the family's power hog: 1000 FE/t over a 50-tick cycle (maxProgress line 32) = 50000 FE per ore produced, and it only works when its laser base points at bedrock-level focus conditions defined by the ore laser base data

Mob crusher: 50 FE/t over 100 ticks per kill cycle (5000 FE per cycle), producing liquid essence from kills; the slaughter factory is the item-drops counterpart - use the crusher when essence is the goal

Plant gatherer: 400 FE/t, 40-tick cycles. Fluid extractor (the latex tap): 500 FE/t over 100 ticks per extraction cycle (FluidExtractorConfig.java lines 32/35), feeding the latex processing unit - the rubber chain's running cost is dominated by the extractor

Machine addons are tiered augments: a speed addon's stored augment value is 1 + tier (tiers run 1 upward), and range/efficiency/processing addons follow the same pattern in their item classes; the Titanium framework applies the augment to the machine's speed, power draw or work area, so check the addon tier before promising a throughput
